text: 金十数据7月23日讯，《全民健身计划（2026—2030年）》指出，将全民健身场地设施建设纳入地方国土空间规划。推动群众身边的场地设施布局建设与常住人口总量、结构、流动趋势相衔接，新增资源优先向人口密集、供需矛盾突出的区域倾斜。实施群众运动空间扩容计划，充分利用城市“金角银边”，盘活利用工业厂房、仓储用房、商业用房、高架桥下、建筑屋顶等存量空间，因地制宜打造全龄友好健身空间，建设更多群众身边“小而美”的全民健身场地设施。新建或改扩建一批小（微）型体育公园、小型健身中心、多功能运动场、小型足球场地、群众滑冰场等场地设施，增加球类、冰雪等运动人口增长较快项目
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 23 - The 'National Fitness Plan (2026-2030)' states that the construction of national fitness facilities will be included in local territorial spatial planning. The layout of fitness facilities near the public will be coordinated with the total, structure, and mobility trends of the permanent population, with new resources prioritized for densely populated areas with prominent supply-demand imbalances. An expansion plan for public sports space will be implemented, fully utilizing urban 'golden corners and silver edges', revitalizing existing spaces such as industrial plants, storage rooms, commercial properties, under-viaduct areas, and building rooftops, to create age-friendly fitness spaces tailored to local conditions and build more 'small yet beautiful' national fitness facilities for the public. New or renovated small (micro) sports parks, small fitness centers, multi-purpose sports fields, small football fields, and public skating rinks will be built to add sports populations for ball games and ice-snow sports showing faster growth.
